feat: style-bound host feature activation (#272)

* feat(shell): drop builtin shell actions

Shell items are feature slots only. Operators add HOME, locale, and logout as real features when they need them.

* chore(shell): drop sermon from the feature-only migration

* feat(vega): search features when adding a shell item

* chore(mercury): register checksum for feature-only shell migration

* feat(dalim): add composition activation form

Styles can declare page or invoke launch without putting that choice on the feature key. Invoke action types are ID-shaped so catalog membership can stay a management check.

* feat(vega): import missing style actions into the catalog

Preview still fails when a bundle calls an unknown action, but the page now names those actions and can register them after a risk confirmation. Built-in host actions stay in code.

* chore(orion): point submodule at activation Dart contracts

Dalim check compares generated composition v2 Dart in the Orion checkout, so this branch needs the matching activation types.

* fix(mercury): drop foreign keys from app shell surfaces

Mercury forbids REFERENCES in migrations. Parent and child rows stay linked by application writes and the integrity scanner.

* chore(orion): point submodule at pattern-based activation Dart

Dalim check compares generated composition v2 Dart in the Orion checkout to the relaxed actionType pattern.

* style(vega): format shell files with Prettier

Check runs format-check after Mercury tests, so these files blocked the feature-only branch once the migration gate passed.

* style(vega): format the style-bundle import action test

Keep format-check green on the activation branch after the missing-action import coverage landed.

* fix(vega): restore typecheck for shell and release style views

Studio routes need the same session service cast as other feature pages. Empty action cells and optional style names must match their prop types.

* chore(orion): point submodule at formatted shell Dart

Cosmos Check runs Orion format-check, so this branch needs the matching formatter commit.

* chore(orion): point submodule at fully formatted shell Dart

* chore(orion): point submodule at dispatcher test import fix

* chore(orion): point submodule at style-bundle test timeout

* chore(orion): point submodule at missing-payload page open

* chore(vega): regenerate platform OpenAPI client for shell and import-actions

generate-check diffs this file against the live Mercury contract. Shell and import-actions routes were missing.

* chore(vega): regenerate platform OpenAPI client for app shell routes

generate-check diffs this file against the live Mercury contract. The shell GET and PUT routes were missing.

* chore(orion): point submodule at runtime shell Dart client

generate-check diffs the Tonik runtime client against the live contract.

* chore(orion): point submodule at runtime shell and activation client

generate-check diffs the Tonik runtime client against the live contract.

* chore(orion): point submodule at merged runtime client

* chore(orion): point submodule at hidden generated shell types

* chore(orion): point submodule at hidden generated shell types

* chore(orion): point submodule at empty-shell test fixtures

Manifest fixtures now include the required shell object so Quality Check can decode RuntimeManifestResponse.

* fix(shell): mark unselected styles inactive in Studio and runtime

Release snapshots stay a capability pool. An App must choose a snapshot style before a shell item is valid or shipped. Vega now reports that as no_style.

* chore(orion): point submodule at unselected-feature STAC gating

* chore(orion): pin submodule to the merged activation squash
